trusted_sections: Task 15: Complete extension proof and architecture-boundary tests
Task 16: Run Windows/Web physical closure and record evidence

trusted_statements.objective: Close the PX0 Debug Control Plane with test-only extension/boundary proof plus exact Windows/Web physical qualification evidence. PX0-07 is closure/evidence only and must not implement new product behavior.
px0_success_boundary: Current useful Brush/Eraser, selection, history, Surface, Arc, telemetry and diagnostics behavior is preserved.
Product behavior mutates only through product-safe RuntimeFacade contracts.
Engineering-only mutation routes through explicit debug-control owners.
Panels consume one bounded immutable structured snapshot assembled in common code.
A synthetic feature can extend Control and Inspect through stable contribution slots without Workbench/platform-host redesign.
Windows and Web hosts remain thin presentation/input realizations around common DebugController.
Deterministic contract tests and Windows/Web physical validation close PX0.

extension_proof.required_behavior: Synthetic contributions are accepted, discoverable and renderable through PanelRegistry/Workbench contracts without modifying Workbench core, platform hosts or adding Shape/product semantics.

architecture_boundary_proof: DebugPanelContext contains only const DebugSnapshot&, DebugControlRouter&, DebugUiSessionState& and no Runtime/Document/Scene/Skia/owner pointers.
DebugSnapshot does not require a global Capability[] field.
No generic canvas::debug_ui::DebugCommand or generic BoundedCommandQueue mutation lane exists; typed owner queues such as canvas::runtime::BoundedAxiomDebugCommandQueue are allowed.
One unavailable provider does not block independent snapshot sections.
Fit Selection and Fit Primary Object do not fall back to Fit Content when context is invalid.
Mixed-generation snapshot coherence remains explicit and observable.

physical_platform_scope.rule: Physical qualification records actual Available/DisabledByContext/Unsupported platform behavior. It must not report PASS for a control the owner reports Unsupported.

physical_checklist: Surface Platform / CPU / GPU controls where supported
hidden Debug UI does not consume Canvas input
Debug-owned pointer/keyboard sequence does not leak to Canvas

platform_expectations.windows: Product controls are exercised through the converged RuntimeFacade path. Surface engineering controls are exercised only when PlatformDebugControl reports them available.
platform_expectations.web: Product controls are exercised through the converged Web RuntimeFacade path. Engineering controls without bound Web debug owners are recorded Unsupported rather than treated as failures.

evidence_identity_model.qualification_subject_revision: The exact repository revision after Task 15 test/CMake closure and before the human-readable physical evidence index commit. Windows/Web builds and physical observations are performed against this exact revision.
evidence_identity_model.evidence_head: A later evidence-only/docs revision that records physical observations and points back to qualification_subject_revision. This avoids self-referential result-revision churn.
evidence_identity_model.gate_owner: Official PX0/P34 verdict remains owned by independent Control Review, never by Task 16 evidence prose.

preserved_non_goals: No final Product Shell toolbar/context UI.
No ImGui docking or multi-window debugger.
No RuntimeScene tree browser or raw SemanticDocument editing.
No stable Runtime C ABI change.
No Android/iOS physical parity as a PX0 blocker.

forbidden_interpretations: PX0-07 is not permission to fix or redesign production implementation while adding closure tests.
Synthetic feature contributions are test fixtures only and must not add Shape or successor-feature product behavior.
Unsupported controls are not physical failures when the approved owner/build intentionally does not implement them.
Physical evidence may document a failure, but it may not redefine the frozen control contract or issue official Gate PASS.
The evidence index commit is not the same identity as the qualification subject revision; it must reference the exact subject instead of recursively naming itself.
